preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have admin privileges via setAdminAddress)
Contract must have positive token balance in its address(this) account (from accumulated bounsFee)

exploit_hint: As owner, call sumTheBounsPool() with appropriate date strings (yesToday, twoYesToday) to transfer half of contract's token balance to dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. Then manipulate dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] via sumBounsPiece() to set a high piece value. Finally, call receiveBounsToken() (if eligible) or wait for users to claim rewards at inflated rates, allowing you to drain the bonus pool. Alternatively, repeatedly call sumTheBounsPool() to accumulate unclaimed rewards in dayPoolBouns mapping.
